progress_args_monitocontinuous.description: If true, sets the -M flag (monitor continuously, similar to watch).

progress_args_monitor.description: If true, sets the -m flag (loop while monitored processes are still running).

progress_args_quiet.description: If true, sets the -q flag (hide all messages).

progress_args_debug.description: If true, sets the -d flag (show all warning/error messages).

progress_args_wait.description: If true, sets the -w flag (estimate I/O throughput and remaining time).

progress_args_wait_delay.description: Sets the -W argument value (seconds to wait for I/O estimation). Requires wait=true.

progress_args_commands.description: List of command names to monitor exclusively (-c flag). Can be used multiple times.

progress_args_additional_commands.description: List of additional command names to add to the default coreutils list (-a flag). Can be used multiple times.

progress_args_pids.description: List of numeric PIDs to monitor exclusively (-p flag). Can be used multiple times.

progress_args_ignore_files.description: List of absolute file paths to ignore in reports (-i flag). Can be used multiple times.

progress_args_open_mode.description: Open mode for file reporting: 'r' (read) or 'w' (write). Sets the -o flag.
